expected_revision.description: Candidate revision. Revision candidates additionally require expected_target_revision equal to stored base_aggregate_revision.

current_publication.description: Current candidate revision's publication; enables refresh recovery without storing sensitive content or guessing IDs.

session_id.description: Tool session ID is also its refresh-token family ID; absolute family expiry is at most 7 days.

SearchHit.description: Budgeted search segment; revision is content revision. Not a complete detail.

KnowledgeDetail.description: Full versioned body; maturity/freshness belong to requested content revision, publication/serving and aggregate_revision are current aggregate state. Historical content never implies current applicability.

expected_revision.description: Current target knowledge aggregate_revision, not candidate or content revision.
